title: The Unit Vector of Direction
body: The velocity vector of a military convoy is $$\vec{v}=(4.000\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}})\hat{i}+(3.000\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}})\hat{j}+(0.100\,\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}})\hat{k}$$. $$What$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$unit$$ $$vector$$ $$of$$ $$its$$ $$direction$$ $$of$$ $$motion$$?
